Durability of the Medicaid supplemental/directed-payment-program (DPP) net benefit - now guided to ~$1.5B against a $2.66B FY2026 adj-EBITDA midpoint, i.e. ~56% of guided EBITDA (UP from ~41% at the 07-16 grade) - as the OBBBA phases DPP/provider-tax caps in from FY2028. 2026Q2 made the hinge SHARPER, not looser: management added ~$150M of incremental DPP precisely to absorb ~$200M of unbudgeted operating adversity, so the policy tailwind is now the load-bearing element of the algorithm rather than a supplement to it.
